name: opensimula-editor-vendor
description: Builds the anywidget front ends, static/editor.js (editor.src.js with Ajv) static/results.js (results.src.js with uPlot) and static/plotly3d.js (plotly gl3d as an ES module, sent by Python when a 3D view is opened): each bundled with its dependencies into one self-contained ESM module with no runtime imports of any kind, since anywidget loads it from a blob URL where relative/bare imports can't resolve, and VS Code's notebook webview CSP additionally blocks fetching third-party scripts.

scripts.build: esbuild editor.src.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=../static/editor.js && esbuild results.src.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --loader:.css=text --outfile=../static/results.js && esbuild plotly3d.src.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=../static/plotly3d.js
